subject.title: feat: let plugins control inbound debounce policy

question: Should inbound debounce remain WhatsApp-owned per-conversation configuration, or become a generic plugin SDK contract that supported channels invoke consistently?
rationale: The branch currently combines both directions while exposing a generic hook that only WhatsApp calls, so implementation review cannot determine the permanent public contract safely.

options.title: Split and narrow
options.body: Land the WhatsApp configuration solution separately and defer the generic hook until a shared multi-channel contract is designed and proven.

options.title: Approve a generic hook
options.body: Keep the hook only after moving invocation to an approved shared inbound seam and documenting and testing consistent channel behavior.

options.title: Approve WhatsApp-only policy
options.body: Rename and scope the contract explicitly to WhatsApp, with owner approval and compatibility tests that prevent plugins from assuming broader coverage.

recommendation.title: Split and narrow
recommendation.body: Land the WhatsApp configuration solution separately and defer the generic hook until a shared multi-channel contract is designed and proven.

likelyOwner.reason: The discussion already sought this person's contract direction, and their recent history is closest to the affected WhatsApp runtime boundary.
